description: This PHP file defines the SubpanelQuickEdit class responsible for handling quick edit forms within subpanels of the SuiteCRM application. It manages view selection, bean retrieval, and rendering of the quick edit interface, integrating with other CRM components.

classes.name: SubpanelQuickEdit
classes.description: A class that handles rendering and processing of quick edit forms within subpanels in SuiteCRM, including view setup, bean handling, and display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the quick edit form, determines view definitions, retrieves the bean if record ID is provided, and sets up the edit view with template configurations.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes and renders the quick edit form for the specified module, invoking the view's process and display methods.
